note: Unpublished local preview prepared before the raw-image checkpoint. Withdrawn from the active catalogue after owner feedback; all native and finished artwork remains in this study.

description.en: A complete firefly rises toward the upper right. Its amber abdomen carries the visual weight; parted wing cases suggest the gesture of opening pages.
description.zh: 完整的萤火虫朝右上方轻盈升起，琥珀色腹部承载视觉重心；微张的翅壳，带一点翻开书页的姿态。

description.en: A matte blue-green shell surrounds a warm, luminous abdomen. Connected coral, violet, and blue wing inlays carry the family’s faceted accents into a more sculptural character.
description.zh: 哑光蓝绿色翅壳与温暖发光的腹部形成对照。内翅上相连的珊瑚色、紫色和蓝色切面，让更具雕塑感的角色延续这个系列的彩色碎片。

description.en: A muted sea-glass field, clear tonal curves, and shallow shadows support the teal silhouette and warm light. The existing blog palette is recorded separately.
description.zh: 柔和的海玻璃色底纹、清楚的同色曲线和浅阴影，衬托蓝绿色轮廓与腹部的暖光。博客原有配色单独记录。

sizeNote.en: At 16 px, the teal-and-gold diagonal and bright abdomen carry the identity. The eye, antennae, legs, and individual inlays simplify; the complete character is clearer at 32 px and above.
sizeNote.zh: 在 16 px 下，蓝绿与金色构成的斜向轮廓、明亮腹部承担主要辨识度；眼睛、触角、足部和彩色切面会简化。32 px 及以上能更清楚地看到完整角色。

subject.en: A hovering teal firefly with a luminous amber abdomen and colorful wing inlays
subject.zh: 悬停的蓝绿色萤火虫，腹部发出琥珀色微光，翅膀带有彩色镶嵌切面
